name: Wang Da-Le
biography: A 30-year-old game-company planner whose creativity at work contrasts with his carelessness toward his marriage. After repeatedly ruining his wedding anniversary, a mysterious taxi driver transports him to a parallel timeline where he must confront the consequences of his choices.
personality: Optimistic, kind, imaginative, humorous and well-meaning, but immature and careless about keeping promises to his family.

relationships.name: Ho Yung-Chi
relationships.description: His wife in the original timeline; in the alternate timeline she is dating his close friend Wang Shih-Yuan.

relationships.name: Wang Shih-Yuan
relationships.description: A close friend who has repeatedly helped Da-Le with his anniversary plans.

relationships.name: Wang Meile
relationships.relation: older sister in the alternate timeline

characterDevelopment: The parallel-world journey forces Da-Le to recognise how his thoughtlessness has hurt his wife. He gradually learns responsibility, empathy and the daily effort required to sustain a marriage.

name: Ho Yung-Chi
biography: A 30-year-old advertising-company manager and Da-Le's wife. After discovering she is pregnant and facing a career promotion, she becomes unwilling to keep tolerating Da-Le's repeated carelessness. In the alternate timeline she is Wang Shih-Yuan's girlfriend.
personality: Gentle, strong-willed, caring and resilient. She values commitment and hopes to build a secure family, but is hurt by repeated broken promises.

relationships.name: Wang Da-Le
relationships.relation: husband / romantic partner in the original timeline

relationships.name: Wang Shih-Yuan
relationships.relation: romantic partner in the alternate timeline

characterDevelopment: Her parallel-timeline life highlights her need for reliability, respect and emotional security. Her story explores how family history and unmet expectations affect trust in marriage.

name: Wang Shih-Yuan
biography: A 31-year-old university friend of Da-Le and Ho Yung-Chi and the editor-in-chief of a men's fashion magazine. In the alternate timeline he is Yung-Chi's boyfriend. He was raised in the Wang household after being abandoned by his mother.
personality: Sensitive, restrained and observant. He suppresses his own needs to keep others happy and carries gratitude toward, but also insecurity around, the Wang family.

relationships.name: Wang Da-Le
relationships.description: Da-Le treats him like a brother; Shih-Yuan feels both grateful and insecure about his place in the Wang family.

relationships.name: Ho Yung-Chi
relationships.relation: romantic partner in the alternate timeline

characterDevelopment: His alternate-timeline relationship with Yung-Chi brings his long-suppressed feelings and his complicated sense of loyalty to the Wang family into focus.

name: Ding Peizhong
biography: Wang Meile's husband and a member of the Wang family's alternate-timeline household.

name: Wang Meile
biography: Da-Le's older sister in the alternate timeline. She is married to Ding Peizhong and has a daughter, Ding Shasha.

name: Yao Qiongling
biography: Da-Le's 58-year-old mother. She secretly learns photo editing to help her husband's traditional photography studio survive the transition to digital photography.
personality: Kind, cheerful, generous, supportive and an excellent cook; she helps keep the family emotionally close.
characterDevelopment: She uses practical support and new editing skills to help her husband preserve the family business and encourages him to keep taking photographs.

name: Wang Baifu
biography: Da-Le's 60-year-old father and the owner of the family photography studio. He built the business from the ground up as a photographer and photo developer, but struggled to keep it alive as digital photography and mobile phones changed the market.
personality: Artistic, hardworking, traditional and devoted to his family.
characterDevelopment: He faces retirement and the decline of the traditional photo studio, while his wife's support helps him adapt and continue pursuing photography.

name: Ding Shasha
biography: The young daughter of Wang Meile and Ding Peizhong in the alternate timeline.

name: Zhang Ailian
biography: Ho Yung-Chi's 56-year-old mother, a relationship writer and popular livestream personality. She has built a public image around independence and self-respect after an unhappy marriage.
personality: Articulate, guarded about her own private life, perfectionistic and pessimistic about romantic relationships.

relationships.name: Wang Shih-Yuan
relationships.relation: daughter's romantic partner in the alternate timeline

characterDevelopment: Her rigid expectations and cynical views on marriage create conflict with Yung-Chi, even though she believes she is teaching her daughter to be independent.

name: Mike
biography: A named supporting character credited in the 2019 Taiwanese drama Déjà vu.

name: Hong Yuqian
biography: A 22-year-old woman who runs a burger food truck while trying to recover the recipes left by her late parents. She is drawn to Da-Le after he shows her care and helps her.
personality: Cheerful, lively, stubborn and competitive; she hides vulnerability behind a worldly and mature outlook.
characterDevelopment: Her connection with Da-Le grows as he offers her help and attention; she gradually develops feelings for him while dealing with the loss of her parents.

name: Jack
biography: A named supporting character credited in the 2019 Taiwanese drama Déjà vu.

name: Chai Kefu / Ho Lan-Cheng (Tchaikov)
biography: A 44-year-old mysterious taxi driver who transports Da-Le into a parallel timeline. His origins are unclear, and his intervention gives Da-Le and other characters an opportunity to reconsider their lives.
personality: Quiet, reserved and perceptive, with an unusually penetrating gaze.

relationships.name: Wang Da-Le
relationships.description: The driver transports Da-Le to the alternate timeline and makes him confront his choices.

characterDevelopment: He acts as the catalyst for Da-Le's parallel-world journey. His identity and motives remain mysterious for much of the story.
